//version: A path, not a number. The bundle version is the repository's version — read from package.json rather than restated here, because a second copy is a copy that drifts. It already had: this file said 0.1.0 through the v0.2.0 and v0.2.1 tags, which would have named every artifact after a version nobody released.

build.//: The frontend is the repository's own src/, taken as it stands. Not a copy, not a variant, not a build output — the same files the website serves. This is the single most important line in the file: it is what stops the desktop app becoming a second implementation that drifts.

windows.label: main
windows.title: RealtimeClipboard
windows.//: Started hidden when launched at login (--hidden). The window is shown from the tray, or by the global hotkey.

app.//security: The webview renders clipboard content that arrives from other devices, so it gets the same policy the website has, plus what the shell needs. tauri: and ipc: are the local scheme the frontend uses to reach the four commands in main.rs; asset: is how the bundled files are served. The relay origins must match src/core/config.js — tests/unit/static-check.mjs asserts that for the web pages, and a self-hoster changes both.

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; img-src 'self' asset: data: blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://realtimeclipboard.fastapicloud.dev wss://realtimeclipboard.fastapicloud.dev; require-trusted-types-for 'script'; trusted-types realtimeclipboard

trayIcon.//iconAsTemplate: false, and it must stay false while the tray icon is icons/icon.png. A macOS template image is drawn from its ALPHA channel alone, and that icon is a full-bleed opaque square — as a template it renders as a solid black block in the menu bar, not as a clipboard. Turning this on needs a separate monochrome-on-transparent tray asset, which would then be invisible on a dark Windows taskbar; hence one colour icon for all three.
trayIcon.//: Left click shows the window. Quit lives in the menu, because an app that watches your clipboard must have a visible way to stop it.

bundle.//targets: One list, every desktop platform. tauri-action picks the ones the runner can produce.
bundle.shortDescription: An encrypted clipboard shared between your devices
bundle.longDescription: Copy on one machine and paste on another. RealtimeClipboard watches the system clipboard and sends what you copy, end-to-end encrypted, to the other devices sharing a five-character key. No account, and nothing is written to disk on any machine or on the relay.

windows.//: Signing is not optional for this app specifically: SmartScreen and most antivirus treat an unsigned binary that reads the clipboard and opens outbound TLS as suspicious, which is a fair description of what it does. Supplied by CI from secrets; empty here so a local build still works.

macOS.//: Notarization is MANDATORY, not advisory: without it Gatekeeper refuses the download outright rather than warning. CI supplies APPLE_* from secrets.

deb.//: webkit2gtk 4.1 is the floor. Named explicitly so apt refuses the install on a distribution too old to run it, rather than installing a binary that fails at launch with a missing symbol.
